charge_port.notes: Porsche US/Canada: "CCS-equipped Taycan" needs the NACS DC adapter; CCS1 for North America. Native NACS starts with MY2027.

supercharger_access.notes: US: Porsche NACS DC adapter (included with MY2026, free for MY2025, purchasable for MY2024 and older at $185).
Canada: same programme; adapter free for MY2025 and MY2026, C$250 for MY2024 and older.

wheels.notes: Estimated: the 2024 Taycan 4 Cross Turismo AWD page shows 19-inch; the 2026 same trim is assumed unchanged. Carried from another model year or trim, not read for this exact trim and year.
